note: Gate identifiers follow this round's own numbering. `criterion` restates what was checked; the authoritative wording is the task book.

gates.criterion: Baseline identity: HEAD unchanged, three P1 archives byte-identical to the ones named in the task book, 26 P1 source files match the SEAL-01 manifest.
Duplicate successor simulation reproduced and frozen BEFORE any production change, with per-call identity and per-call output equality.
Minimal production implementation: one simulation per candidate action per node, single candidate-enumeration source, no downstream change.
Rule transition parity: every prepared transition equals an independent fresh simulation (kind, stateKey, full state JSON).

CHANCE contract: outcome count and order from the RuleSet enumeration, uniform weights summing to 1, one pending ghost per outcome, deferred materialisation when occupied, auto-pickup, no RNG sampling.
Search mathematics unchanged: mate propagation, alpha-beta, transposition-table admission, stateKey, plan upper bound.
Action ordering, originalIndex mapping, tunnel-exit handling, empty batch on terminal phases, trap and skill preconditions preserved.
20 special-rule paths replayed on the real engine.
catBaseMoves 4/6/9, irregular Void/Wall map, trap/butter terrain identity.
Real-time behaviour at 100 ms main search / 150 ms whole turn (diagnostic, not authoritative).
gates.caveat: Single sampling is not reproducible at a 100 ms cliff. Two passes disagreed, so the gate was repeated 5x and the variance is reported instead of one flattering table.

gates.criterion: Does the candidate search more inside the same wall budget?
gates.verdictDetail: MORE_SEARCH_WITHIN_100MS = YES. BETTER_VERIFIED_DECISION = NONE: which roots change plan flips run to run, and no adversarial verification supports any changed plan.

gates.criterion: A/A calibration: 20 fresh repetitions, both arms identical source, fully serial.
A/B: 20 fresh repetitions, A = frozen baseline arm, B = candidate, one Node process per arm per repetition, strictly serial.
Full serial regression, first pass, no rerun-to-green.

measured.testCountArithmetic: CHECKPOINT-01 1000 -> OPENING-STACK-01 1026 (+1 file/+26) -> OPENING-SEAL-01 1027 (+1) -> this round 1045 (+1 file/+18)

gates.criterion: New candidate archived separately, restorable outside the repository, three P1 archives untouched.
Scope discipline: no rule, H1, search-math, TT, stateKey, plan-bound, 100/150 ms constant, sidecar, guard or mouse-AI change; no commit/push/merge; no second optimisation.

absoluteDeadlineNote: The 8.50 % figure is a relative speedup on a fixed workload. It is NOT evidence that a whole cat turn fits in 150 ms on any machine. The M1/M2 distribution gates are a narrower measurement domain and are not substituted here.
recommendationRationale: Three production files, one of them new; downstream ordering / TT / alpha-beta / tie-break / equal-primary graph / plan extraction untouched.
24/24 frozen roots field-by-field identical to the frozen baseline at fixed D1; 91/91 transitions identical to an independent simulation; 20/20 special-rule paths pass.
8.50 % faster on a fixed workload with a paired 95 % CI of [0.9027, 0.9274] against an A/A noise floor of +-0.8 %; 0/24 roots slower.
Full regression 83/83 files, 1041 passed, 4 pre-existing skips, exit 0; tsc and vite both exit 0.
More nodes explored within the same 100 ms in 5/5 diagnostic runs, with no root ever losing a completed plan and no new fallback.
notClaimed: Stronger play. No adversarial verification supports any changed plan; G1T3 moving depth 1 -> depth 2 and repricing +32.97 -> -536.11 shows D1 is too shallow to judge, not that the new plan is better.
Removal of DAG re-expansion duplication (1258 redundant calls remain, 16.8 % of the new total). That needs TT/graph-search work and is out of scope this round.
openQuestionsForArchitectureReview: Free trap placement + unconditional trapControl: it now surfaces in more roots because the candidate finishes depth 1 where the baseline fell back. Add a temporal term?

Depth-1 defensive blind spot: 23/24 roots still only reach depth 1 at 100 ms, so a one-turn mouse tactic (ghost butter bait) stays outside the horizon. Add an explicit mouse-oil + ghost threat term at D1?
generateBoxPositions samples only the inner ring, so boxes never reach the outer ring (24/24 real turns had boxesAdjacentToCorners=0). This is a map-generation defect, not a search defect.
Plan stability vs time budget needs its own observable. One depth step moved G1T3's value by 569 points, so single-episode plan comparison cannot rank configurations.
selfDisclosedProcessIssues: The first version of the PT-9/PT-10 section was written from a single sample and was wrong; a second identical run contradicted it. Both samples were kept and 3 more added.
The first A/A driver run was cut off by the sandbox with a stale lock file; the 40 shards were preserved as an independent replicate and A/A was rerun from scratch.
duplicate_witness_pre.json was regenerated once before any production edit (to add the searchOnly subset); both captures predate the fix by mtime.
A whitespace-only edit to expectiminimax.ts during the regression run was reverted; final sha256 matches the manifest exactly.
process.resourceUsage().maxRSS is always 0 on Windows, so only RSS is recorded, never peak RSS.

parseRegression.mjs first failed to match the vitest summary because of ANSI colour codes and reported NOT_PERFORMED rather than guessing; null counts are now explicitly documented as 'reporter omitted, therefore 0'.
processNote: Stopped after this round. No H1, sidecar or tactical optimisation was started. Handing the evidence to the architecture review for the PASS/FAIL decision and the next step.
